import type { ImportedOptions } from "./options";

export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: ImportedOptions) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

export async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], options: ImportedOptions) {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

class Impostor {
  async inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: ImportedOptions) {
    for (const item of items) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
      await step(item);
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
      await audit(item);
    }
  }
}

// ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
inOrder(items, operation);
inOrder(items, operation, { reason: "Each update reads the prior result" });
